sources.imageCredit: Official Miu Miu Holiday 2026 campaign image. Photograph: Tina Barney.
sources.usageStatus: Official brand image embedded; verify distribution permission before live send.
sources.selectedBecause: Tina Barney photographs Miu Miu’s holiday cast inside a townhouse dressed with fir branches, polished wood and winter light. The scenes have the formality of a family portrait, loosened by plush animals and unexpected pairings of tailoring, sequins and outerwear. Barney’s eye for domestic theatre gives each person room to occupy the frame, while styling and setting turn a seasonal gathering into a layered picture of character.

sources.imageCredit: Official LOEWE Spring Summer 2027 precollection campaign image. Photography: Talia Chetrit and Julian Klincewicz.
sources.usageStatus: Official brand image embedded; verify distribution permission before live send.
sources.selectedBecause: LOEWE’s precollection follows Diego Calva, Victoria Luengo, Kristine Frøseth and Jiang Qiming through Madrid’s markets, modernist buildings and tiled bars. Talia Chetrit and Julian Klincewicz photograph bold colour and hybrid materials against the city’s changing surfaces. The campaign’s value lies in the relationship between wardrobe and location: a garment shifts character as a person moves through different rooms, streets and moments of the day.

sources.imageCredit: Official Burberry Festive 2026 campaign image. Film direction: Harmony Korine.
sources.usageStatus: Official brand image embedded; verify distribution permission before live send.
sources.selectedBecause: For its 170th year, Burberry gathers a cast at Longleat House for a playful country-house celebration directed by Harmony Korine. Fiona Shaw and Pierce Brosnan welcome guests from film, fashion and sport, making the campaign feel populated rather than posed in isolation. Checks, outerwear and the rooms themselves create a shared visual language. Its energy comes from the way distinct personalities inhabit one setting, each adding a note to the larger picture.
